business_summary: Dongguan Changlian New Materials Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of water-based printing materials in China and internationally. The company offers water-based printing pastes comprising environmentally-friendly elastic, nylon, heat transfer, biodegradable, cracking, crack-resistant, fireproof, thick plate, and photochromic adhesives, as well as imitation silicon adhesives; environmentally-friendly base coats, foaming pulps, three-dimensional slurry pulling, webbing pulps, hot stamping pastes, transfer flocking pastes, cold ironing pastes, anti-sublimation primers, water slurry, matte top coats, shoe material thick board pulps, bag base coats, imitation discharge printing pastes, dot pulps, denim glues, imitation hot stamping gold/sliver, light-reflecting agents, glitter pastes, conductive pastes, and sanding mortars; and dispensing inks. It also provides silkscreen silicone products, including thick, right-angle, molded, transfer, webbing, shoe material, underwear fit, glossy cover, and matte cap silicone; rubber compounds, such as precipitated rubber compounds, vapor phase rubber compounds, and specialty rubber compounds; and digital printing products, including digital white glues, breathable digital pulps, velvet digital pastes, digital processing fluids, and direct-to-garment ink treatment solutions. In addition, the company offers water-based resins; textile printing auxiliary materials and auxiliaries; water-based coatings; and automated equipment, such as automatic oval printing machines, digital direct ink heatsink printers, and digital station direct injection machines. Further, it engages in network technology development; import and export of goods and technologies; production of information chemicals and electronic materials; and leasing of properties. Dongguan Changlian New Materials Technology Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2009 and is headquartered in Dongguan, China.
